name: Wireframe Warfare
storyline:
Your Cyber Beacon is under attack! Defend your system with the new Tactical Armored Nexus Keeper program, or T.A.N.K for short, and blow those messy viruses to pieces. Armed with lasers to micro turrets, T.A.N.K will keep you in the fight with a varied arsenal of weapons.

Need help? T.A.N.K comes equipped with the Secure Tower Allocation and Network Defense protocol, or S.T.A.N.D for short, that allows you to place defensive towers to fend off any rogue viruses.

Is your T.A.N.K program feeling weak or fragile? Collect Cyber Doubloons to increase your combat effectiveness and purchase attachments to augment your T.A.N.K to fit your own style.
summary: Wireframe Warfare is a Singleplayer Action/Tower Defense hybrid game created by a solo developer over the course of a year. Blast and strategize your way through various levels, combating waves of viruses attacking Cyber Beacons across the pathways of a digital space.
